48.original: Welcome, welcome, fair traveler! Care to test your luck with a Mini Cactpot ticket?

49.original: Try your hand at the Mini Cactpot?

52.original: Very well, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. But remember: with the Mini Cactpot, prosperity's but a scratch away!

53.original: Splendid, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>! Now, allow me to explain: Mini Cactpot is a game of chance, available to you thrice every day.

54.original: Playing is simplicity itself: just guess the value of the covered numbers to win it big. If Nymeia's grace is with you, you'll be rewarded with Manderville Gold Saucer points galore!

56.original: You can now purchase Mini Cactpot tickets.

57.original: You can now purchase up to three Mini Cactpot tickets per day.

58.original: The counter for Mini Cactpot tickets resets daily at <hex:0206020103><hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).

59.original: Each Mini Cactpot ticket has nine slots arranged in a three-by-three grid. Each slot is randomly assigned a number from one to nine. When you purchase a ticket, a single number will be revealed.

60.original: To play, uncover any three other numbers. Based on that information, guess the sum of each line.

61.original: Finally, select a single line. The payout of MGP will depend upon the total sum of the line you have chosen.
